summary: [¶] In accordance with the Competitive Bidding Guidelines, BEC has to certify that the tariff has been discovered through a transparent process of bidding and the tariff discovered is in line with prevailing market prices. In the minutes of Bid Evaluation Committee meeting held on 25.7.2019, the following has been recorded: [para 4] 4. The e- Reverse Auction started on 19 th July, 2019 at 1130 Hrs (IST) on MSTC portal. After 39 rounds of bidding, following levelised Transmission Tariff for each bidder (in ascending order) emerged: [¶] b. The entire bid process has been carried out in accordance with the “Tariff based Competitive Bidding Guidelines for Transmission Service” and “Guidelines for encouraging competition in development of the Transmission Projects” issued by Ministry of Power, Govt. of India under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 and as amended from time to time. [para 25] 25. Bid Evaluation Committee vide its certificate dated 25.7.2019 has certified as under: [¶] - a. The entire bid process has been carried out in accordance with the "Tariff based Competitive Bidding Guidelines for Transmission Service" and "Guidelines for encouraging competition in development of the Transmission Projects" issued by Ministry of Power, Govt. of India under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 and as amended from time to time. [¶] the successful bidder and the levelised tariff of the Project has been carried out by the BPC through a transparent process of competitive bidding in accordance with the Guidelines issued by the Ministry of Power, Government of India under Section 63 of the Act. BEC has certified that the process is in conformity with the Ministry of Power Guidelines. BEC in its certificate dated 25.7.2019 has certified that Sterlite Grid 14 Limited has emerged as the successful bidder after conclusion of e-Reverse auction with lowest levelised transmission charges of Rs. 847.44 million per annum. BEC has further certified that the levelised tariff computed on the basis of rates quoted by the successful bidder, [¶] during e-Reverse auction, is lower than the levelised tariff calculated based on CERC norms. Based on the certification of the BEC, we approve and adopt the transmission charges for the Project as per the Appendix to this order which shall remain valid throughout the period covered in the TSA. The sharing of the transmission charges by the LTTCs shall be governed by the provisions of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of inter-State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2010 as amended from time to time. [para 28] 28. The Petition No. 336/AT/2019 is disposed of in terms of the above.
title: Application under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for adoption of transmission charges with respect to the Transmission System being established by Udupi Kasargode Transmission Limited. Udupi Kasargode Transmission Limited
